title.rendered: Portable Cabins in East Delhi: Site Offices, Classrooms and Toilets

content.rendered:
A portable cabin in East Delhi is a factory-built steel-frame room delivered ready to use for site offices, classrooms, a cabin with attached toilet, security posts or storage across Mayur Vihar, Shahdara, Laxmi Nagar and Anand Vihar. SAMAN Portable manufactures these cabins and dispatches them from our Greater Noida factory, so contractors, schools and municipal teams in East Delhi get usable space without permanent construction.

Each cabin uses an MS steel frame built to IS 2062 with insulated PUF sandwich panels, so it stands up to Delhi summers and monsoon rain. Below you will find what drives the price, the common sizes, delivery to East Delhi and how to request a quote.

What a Portable Cabin Costs in East Delhi

There is no single fixed price — the cost of a portable cabin in East Delhi depends on the floor size, the panel type and thickness, the insulation, whether you add a toilet or internal partitions, the electrical fit-out, the finish level and the delivery distance to your site. The honest way to budget is to share your size and use, and request a written quote.

Key price factors to tell us when you enquire:

  • Floor size in feet (for example 10×10, 20×10 or 40×10)
  • Single panel skin or insulated PUF sandwich panel, and panel thickness
  • Use type — site office, classroom, cabin with attached toilet, security post or storage
  • Internal partitions, windows, doors and electrical points
  • Finish level — economy, standard or premium interior
  • Delivery distance from our Greater Noida factory to your East Delhi site

Buying factory-direct from the manufacturer removes the dealer margin, so you pay for the cabin and transport, not a middleman.

Common Sizes and Uses for East Delhi Buyers

Site offices for construction projects

Contractors across Shahdara, Patparganj and Anand Vihar use portable cabin offices to run projects on-site. A cabin office gives supervisors and engineers a desk space with storage and electrical points, and it can be relocated as the project moves between phases.

Classrooms for schools

Schools in Mayur Vihar and Preet Vihar use portable classroom cabins for extra space during renovations or rising enrolment. Insulated panels keep the room cooler, and units can be fitted with windows, lighting and ventilation suited to a learning space.

Cabin with attached toilet

A portable cabin can be supplied with an attached toilet and washroom fittings — useful for construction sites and public spaces in Laxmi Nagar and Mayur Vihar that need clean facilities for workers. These units have proper plumbing connections and ventilation, and can run on a water tank where no mains line is available.

Security cabins and storage

Compact security cabins suit gate posts at residential complexes and commercial properties in East Delhi, with visibility windows and electrical connections. Weatherproof storage cabins protect materials, inventory or documents on congested sites.

Typical floor sizes range from small 8×8 security posts to 20×10 site offices and larger 40×10 classroom units. Tell us your use and we will recommend a size.

How SAMAN Portable Cabins Are Built

Our portable cabins are built for East Delhi's climate using a structural steel frame and insulated panels rather than thin sheet sheds:

  • MS steel frame manufactured to IS 2062 structural-steel standard
  • Roughly 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (40 kg/m³ minimum density) for heat and sound control
  • Pre-galvanised steel skin and GI roofing with proper slope for monsoon runoff
  • Powder-coated steel for corrosion resistance
  • Sealed joints and a raised base to keep water out during heavy rain
  • Wired electrical points with circuit protection

Manufacturing runs under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system. The same factory-built, dry-assembly method means a cabin can usually be set up on a prepared site quickly and with minimal mess in congested East Delhi lanes.

Finish and Customisation Options

Economy Finish

Functional interior with standard flooring, simple wall finish and essential electrical fittings. Suited to temporary site offices on Shahdara and Patparganj projects.

Standard Finish

Better flooring, painted walls, drop ceilings and additional electrical points. A common choice for classrooms and office cabins.

Premium Finish

Vinyl flooring, panelled walls, improved lighting and climate control. Preferred for longer-term installations.

Cabins can be customised in size, layout, window and door placement, partitioning and toilet fit-out to suit limited urban plots in areas like Laxmi Nagar and Preet Vihar.

Delivery and Installation Across East Delhi

We dispatch portable cabins to East Delhi from our Greater Noida factory, which is the same region — a genuine advantage over suppliers shipping from far away. Standard delivery is charged at ₹3,000 (final cost depends on distance and access), with typical transit of 3–5 days for standard units once your order is confirmed. Custom or fully fitted cabins take longer to build before dispatch.

Our teams are used to narrow access roads in localities like Shahdara, Mayur Vihar and Laxmi Nagar and use compact equipment to place cabins on site with minimal disruption. Note that during Delhi-NCR GRAP construction-ban windows (typically October to February), factory-built dry-assembly cabins are generally not barred the way wet construction is — useful when site timelines are tight.

Why Buy Factory-Direct From SAMAN Portable

SAMAN Portable is the manufacturer, not a reseller. Serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019, we have completed 500+ projects across India. Buying direct means:

  • Manufacturer pricing with no dealer margin
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life
  • 7-day customer-paid return window after delivery or installation
  • IS 2062 steel and ISO 9001:2015 quality system
  • Direct dispatch from our Greater Noida factory to your East Delhi site

Explore the full portable cabin range or see the portable cabin with toilet for site sanitation needs.

Tell us your size, use and site location in Mayur Vihar, Shahdara, Laxmi Nagar or Anand Vihar, and we will send a written quote.

FAQs: Portable Cabins in East Delhi


How long does delivery and installation take in East Delhi?

For standard portable cabins, typical transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days once the order is confirmed, and most single units are placed and set up on a prepared site within a few hours of arrival. Custom or fully fitted cabins take longer to build before dispatch. Multiple-unit orders may take one to two days to install.


What drives the price of a portable cabin in East Delhi?

Price depends on the floor size, panel type and thickness, insulation, whether you add a toilet or partitions, the electrical fit-out, the finish level and delivery distance from our Greater Noida factory. Because there is no fixed SKU price, share your size and use and we will send a written quote.


Can portable cabins handle Delhi monsoons and summer heat?

Yes. Our cabins use GI roofing with proper slope for runoff, sealed joints, a raised base and corrosion-resistant powder-coated steel to keep water out during heavy rain. The roughly 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels help keep the interior cooler in summer than a plain sheet structure.


What permissions are needed to install a portable cabin in East Delhi?

For temporary use on private property, minimal permissions are usually needed. For longer-term installations, especially in commercial areas of Laxmi Nagar or Preet Vihar, you may need clearance from local municipal authorities. We can advise on documentation based on your location and intended use. Confirm specific requirements with your local authority before installing.


How is a cabin with attached toilet connected to water and sewage?

A portable cabin with attached toilet can connect to existing water and sewage lines where available. Where there is no direct connection, we can supply an overhead water tank and a collection tank that is serviced periodically. Tell us your site conditions and we will recommend a suitable arrangement.


Can a portable cabin be customised for school use in East Delhi?

Yes. We customise cabins for classroom use with proper ventilation, lighting and insulated panels that reduce outside noise, plus layouts for classrooms, labs or administrative rooms. Units can be sized to fit limited school plots in Mayur Vihar and other East Delhi areas.

Get a Portable Cabin Quote for East Delhi

Ready to solve your space needs in East Delhi? Send your requirement and our team will respond with a customised quote for Mayur Vihar, Shahdara, Laxmi Nagar, Anand Vihar or any other East Delhi location.

Call or message our Delhi-NCR team for a quick quote on your East Delhi portable cabin.
